pages.text: $(thing)Twilight Forest$() is a dark, layered dimension of dense forest, with eight bosses and its own metals and magic items. It was added by hand to this pack.
To enter, dig a small pool, ring it with flowers, and throw a $(item)Diamond$() into the water. Lightning strikes and the portal opens.

pages.title: Ironwood Ingot
pages.text: First of Twilight's metals. Steeleaf, Knightmetal and Fiery metal follow.

pages.title: Block of Knightmetal
pages.text: A later Twilight metal, tougher than Ironwood and Steeleaf.

pages.title: Fiery Ingot
pages.text: Made from Hydra's Fiery Blood. Fiery tools set what they hit on fire.

pages.title: Uncrafting Table
pages.text: Breaks crafted items back into parts. A very useful utility block.

pages.title: Magic Map
pages.text: Maps the forest. Twilight Charms of Keeping and Life also exist.
Bosses, in the usual order: Naga, Lich, Minoshroom, Hydra, Knight Phantoms, Ur-Ghast, Alpha Yeti, Snow Queen. Each leaves a trophy. See $(l:exploration/bosses)Bosses$(/l).

pages.title: Lich Trophy
pages.text: One of eight trophies. Bosses have spawner blocks in their lairs.
